hero.title: Master's in Computer Engineering in Sweden for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Study advanced Computer and Embedded Systems Engineering in Sweden at top-ranked institutes of technology like KTH and Chalmers, mastering wireless hardware, System-on-Chip design, and post-study residence permits.

overview: Sweden is internationally recognized as an innovation powerhouse in telecommunications hardware, automotive electronics, and sustainable embedded systems, maintaining extensive collaborative ties between universities and multinational technology pioneers. Studying a Master of Science in Computer Engineering in Sweden offers Indian students an egalitarian, innovation-driven culture committed to open-source hardware, energy-efficient microelectronics, and systems resilience.

Top Swedish technical universities offer English-taught 2-year Master of Science programs (120 ECTS) in Embedded Systems, System-on-Chip (SoC) Design, and Computer Systems Architecture. The curriculum combines advanced VLSI design, real-time operating systems, wireless communication hardware, hardware verification, and embedded AI, backed by close partnerships with Sweden's telecommunications and semiconductor leaders.

Under Swedish Migration Agency (Migrationsverket) regulations, international graduates completing an accredited Master's degree in Sweden can apply for a post-study residence permit for up to 12 months to seek employment or explore business startup opportunities, provided they satisfy self-sufficiency maintenance funds (SEK 10,656/month for applications submitted in 2026) and comprehensive health insurance requirements. Doctoral graduates may be granted up to 18 months for job seeking, or can apply for Swedish permanent residency after 4 years of doctoral permits.
